A tax-compliance relation now requires a tax-domain object, institution or procedure at the relation-building stage rather than relying on the decision-layer guard alone, so ordinary senses of return, due, file, claim, registration and list keep their own domain. The tax-domain vocabulary was extended with genuine filing-system and assessment terms (eFPS, eBIRForms, surcharge, annual information return, registered business enterprise). A definition frame whose only extra content is an enumerated metadata suffix has no target. A Filipino tax predicate over a named object survives the ordinary-domain and non-tax-action guards.

Traced each residual row to the exact decision rule that fired. A governed tax predicate over the primary target now defeats the non-tax controlling-domain guard, so the controlling relation decides rather than the domain of the surrounding noun. A named statute inside a tax question is subject matter and survives the homograph veto. A coherent concise tax phrase names governed subject matter even when no relation pattern matched. An ordering or listing action over an ordinary population governs its own target, with the action stem widened to adverbial forms.

Placed corrections by traced rule number rather than by textual anchor, after finding an earlier duplicate of the fallback. A tax-canonical acronym used as the requested concept is self-resolving, but only when no metadata-only referent frames it: a for-item suffix supplies no subject and stays materially ambiguous. The true final fallback now admits a coherent concise tax phrase when no ordinary domain governs the target.

A private-contract question whose requested subject is the tax treatment itself is a tax question about that clause: the domain guard and the homograph veto both exist for contractual remedies, not for a tax clause that is the object of the question. A bare taxability predicate with no competing non-tax framing asks about taxability itself, restricted to the bare-predicate shape so a metadata-suffixed referent keeps REFUSE.

Counterfactual generalization pass with R3 held at 3720/3720: a governed tax predicate over the target defeats the domain-noun veto in relation building, as it already does at the decision layer; a bare materially polysemous acronym CLARIFIES rather than refuses; a polysemous acronym inside an explicit tax-procedure question is resolved by that context; and a naming or tagging action in any clause makes label binding the primary task.
